sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You extend your chakra creating a 15-foot radius of aura that occasionally crackles with a soft yellow spark.

If used in combat, the duration of this jutsu becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute. For that duration the aura moves with you, centered on you and each creature of your choice, that begins its turn within your aura has its speed increased by +10 feet until beginning of your next turn.

If used during exploration or land travel, its duration becomes 1 hour and you and your team treat normal travel pace as Fast travel pace.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and allied creatures bonus to their movement speed by an additional +10 feet.
